item.title: State College Regional Airport Recorded Highest Post-COVID Passenger Activity in 2025
item.description: State College Regional Airport in 2025 had its highest level of passenger activity since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, airport officials said on Thursday. item.title: Beaver Stadium to Host Public Ice Skating
item.description: As Beaver Stadium gets ready to host Penn State hockey games for the first time, the public will have the opportunity to enjoy the ice. The rink installed on the field at the stadium will host four ice skating sessions next week, but you'll need to register soon if you want reserve a spot. item.title: Major Winter Storm Expected to Bring Heavy Snowfall to Centre County. Here’s What to Know
item.description: A winter storm spanning a large swath of the country could bring Centre County's largest snow accumulation in more than five years after it arrives late Saturday night. The National Weather Service has issued a winter storm warning for the county from 10 p.m. Saturday to 1 p.m. Monday, with forecasts ranging from 8 to 18 inches of snow for the region. item.title: State College YMCA Celebrates Longtime Swimmer’s 100th Birthday
item.description: The State College YMCA celebrated its oldest active member Friday morning with a surprise birthday gathering honoring Maynard Kohler, a Ferguson Township resident who has spent decades swimming nearly every weekday morning at the facility on West Whitehall Road. Kohler, who turns 100 on Saturday, has been driving himself to the YMCA to swim every Monday through Friday for 22 years. item.description: A winter storm that could result in Centre County's largest snowfall in more than five years is causing closures and impacts on parking and travel. item.title: Penn State Wrestling Racks Up Bonus Points in 51-0 Domination of Maryland
item.description: Penn State wrestling wrapped up its weekend by scoring bonus points in all 10 bouts for a 51-0 blowout of Maryland on Saturday in College Park. The victory was Penn State's third consecutive shutout, sixth in its last seven dual meets and seventh on the year. Now 11-0 on the season and 5-0 in conference, the Nittany Lions extended their NCAA-record for consecutive dual meet wins to 82. item.title: CATA Suspends Service on Sunday Because of Winter Storm
item.description: The Centre Area Transportation Authority will suspend all operations on Sunday in anticipation of hazardous conditions resulting from the incoming winter storm. The suspension includes CATA Bus and CATA Ride paratransit service. "We recognize that this may cause inconvenience for some riders, and this decision was not made lightly," the authority wrote in a news release on Saturday night. item.title: Penn State Hockey Sweeps No. 5 Wisconsin in Pivotal Road Series
item.description: Penn State picked up a pair of impressive wins over Wisconsin this weekend, gaining ground in the Big Ten standings and extending its conference winning streak to a program-best seven games. The No. 8 Nittany Lions defeated the No. 5 Badgers 7-2 on Friday night and followed it up with a 3-1 win Saturday to secure six points, tying Michigan for the top spot in the conference.
